dict.string: Bookland controls Apple Music or Spotify playback, reads the current Apple Music playlist when you open Playing Next, and saves a note to Apple Notes when requested.
Bookland shows your macOS calendars, including Google calendars synced to this Mac, and creates events in the calendar you select.
Bookland listens to your speech only while Voice Prompter is running so it can follow your script.
Bookland uses the camera only while you open the Mirror widget.
Bookland shows AirPods connection and battery activity beside the notch.
Bookland recognizes your speech while Voice Prompter is running to follow your script. On-device recognition is the default.
